evaluation.covariance: log2 local covariance trace of RF residual vectors after independently learned CCF mean map
evaluation.cell_split: deterministic independent halves; covariance recomputed within each half
evaluation.split_templates: training sessions recomputed at matching cell-half or physical-half density; the two subset surfaces are averaged within training animal before animal-balanced templating
evaluation.physical_split: six physical blocks; alternating blocks assigned to halves; covariance recomputed
evaluation.null: conditional-scatter descriptor permuted over exact RF locations
evaluation.rf_size: descriptive absolute improved-fit log2 area only; not an acceptance criterion
